title: Homelife product brochure

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Carry a welcoming identity into instructions so readers can move from interest to confident use.
strategic_value: The house outline and friendly opening can connect Cox Homelife’s promise to concrete setup and alarm guidance.
demonstration: A three-view brochure board shows an orange house outline on the cover, a control-panel explanation, and alarm and emergency-contact spreads.
practical_value: Use the cover to establish the service and the interior hierarchy to distinguish diagrams, steps and urgent information.

content_islands.name: Cover and back
content_islands.spec: Place the large opened cover at left, joining family photography and fine line icons with an orange house outline.

content_islands.name: System spread
content_islands.spec: Place the smaller upper-right spread with control-panel annotations and connected-device icons.

content_islands.name: Alarm spread
content_islands.spec: Place the lower-right spread with numbered alarm stages, phone example and colored emergency-contact bands.

ingredient.name: Orange house outline
ingredient.role: Identify the domestic purpose of the Homelife system and connect the brochure’s front and back.
ingredient.application: Run the house contour across the opened cover, enclosing the family photograph and continuing below the title.
ingredient.scope: This Homelife brochure cover. Interior diagrams use a separate instructional hierarchy.
